protocol: n_train 26715 tmQM, 50-epoch budget, gate=early_stop_metric bond_type_f1 (epsilon 0.85, patience 3); only the seed differs between arms
gate_metric_definition: bond_type_macro_f1_pooled = macro-F1 over bond TYPE, POOLED across all scored pairs (train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:5010). NOT the per-complex aggregation the bench uses -- see tmqm_bond_perception.json::production_scale_comparison_2026_10_11 for why the two cannot be placed side by side.
KEY_FINDING: The three seeds did NOT differ by noise; they differed by how long they trained. seed0 and seed1 early-stopped at ep14/15 (patience 3) at 0.9194/0.9297, while seed2 ran to ep28 and reached 0.9703. The gate value tracks training duration, so the 0.0269 std is a convergence-time spread, not a measurement noise floor. Patience 3 is too short on this cohort: seed0 was still improving when it stopped.
consequence_for_prior_claims: The retracted "objective_terms is the best arm" reading (0.93049 vs 0.91941, gap 0.011) is confirmed refuted and on stronger grounds than first stated: seed1 with NO special configuration reaches 0.9297, inside 0.0005 of that arm. The gap is smaller than the between-seed spread (0.0509), so it cannot support any mechanism claim.
do_not_claim: That 0.9398 +/- 0.0269 beats OpenBabel 0.5051 -- different aggregation (pooled vs per-complex), different cohort (192 val vs 900 bench). A same-protocol re-score of all three checkpoints is the only valid comparison and is recorded separately.

root_cause_found_2026_10_12.finding: DEFAULT_EARLY_STOP_PATIENCE = 3 (train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:720) and NO config sets it. bond_type_f1 routes through --early-stop-patience, NOT the legacy --patience (default 10) that governs decode_ratio.
root_cause_found_2026_10_12.evidence: seed0 last three epochs 0.9031 / 0.8922 / 0.9144 -- still oscillating upward when patience 3 fired at ep13. seed1 stopped at ep15. seed2 escaped the same early window and ran to ep28, reaching 0.9703.
root_cause_found_2026_10_12.consequence: The 0.0269 std is a CONVERGENCE-TIME spread, not a measurement noise floor. seed0's 0.9194 has been serving as this config's headline while it was still improving, so it is a lower bound on the config, not its value.
root_cause_found_2026_10_12.fix: Set train.early_stop_patience explicitly in configs/cfm_fullcorpus_seed*.yaml. Raising it is a protocol change and must be declared in the config with the reason, per AGENTS.md 5.11 -- it must not be left to an argparse default.
root_cause_found_2026_10_12.not_yet_measured: What seed0 / seed1 would reach at patience 10 is UNKNOWN. seed2 is evidence that the ceiling exists, not a measurement of it for those seeds.
